senses.gloss: m. (denom. of צִיר I) one whose eyes discharge a briny liquid, blear-eyed; [Rashi: one whose eyes have a cylindrical shape like a pivot, fr. צִיר II].
units: <cite ref="Bekhorot 44a:12">ib. 44ᵃ</cite> <he>עיניו תרוטות וצִירָנִיּוֹת</he> whose eyes are bleared and granulated; [Rashi: round or pivot-shaped]; <cite ref="Tosefta Bekhorot 5:3">Tosef. ib. V, 3</cite> <he>עיניו מצודניות</he> ed. Zuck. (corr. acc., or read with oth. ed. <he>מְרוֹדָנִיּוֹת</he>).
